_doc: Machine-readable sidecar contract for m365-shared-mailbox. Spec: docs/internal/m365-shared-mailbox-sidecar-contract.md. Generated from the Conduit schemas; guarded by src/credentials/m365-shared-mailbox-contract.test.ts.

sidecarMustReject.description: Any request without a valid service-to-service credential is rejected (401/403) before tool dispatch.
A request without X-M365-Mailbox (or with an empty/disabled-marker value) is rejected; never defaults to /me or another mailbox.
X-M365-Mailbox that is not the connection's pinned mailbox, or a userId/UPN in the arguments, is rejected.
userId / mailbox / upn / userPrincipalName arguments of any value are unknown keys and rejected.

Path parameters must match the allowlist ^[A-Za-z0-9_\-=+]{1,512}$ (Graph ids and well-known folder names) and are rejected otherwise, before URL construction; the sidecar also applies encodeURIComponent to every path parameter.
Strict schemas, no passthrough, at every nesting level.
A string that parses as a JSON object or array is rejected in any field at any depth.

Non-ID query and body strings (filter, select, orderby, search, startDateTime, endDateTime, timeZone, ...) are passed only as encoded query values or in the JSON body, never substituted into a URL path.
JSON-RPC arguments are parsed exactly once; string fields are never JSON-parsed a second time.

Every query value (filter, search, select, orderby, expand, top, skip, startDateTime, endDateTime, ...) is percent-encoded exactly once by the sidecar (URLSearchParams or encodeURIComponent) and never pre-decoded or double-encoded: a value containing '&', '#', '%' or '$expand=' must reach Graph as literal text inside that one parameter, never as a second query parameter. Conduit also rejects those characters in free query strings (defence in depth), requires expand to be empty, and allowlists select/orderby tokens.

mustAccept.note: Sidecar contract test must assert Graph receives exactly one $filter, no $expand, and this literal unchanged.
